lines.en: Hey, you guys, uh, is Monica here?
All right, listen, I just bought something.
I'm not sure she's gonna like it,
and it's gonna seem a little crazy,
but this is something I've wanted since I was a little girl.
No, I wish. Okay, you ready?
-Oh, my God, what-- what is-- what the hell is that?
-Excuse me, but this is a purebred,
-How much did you pay for that?
but I got a pretty good deal.
My grandmother had one of these when I was a little girl,
and it was the sweetest thing.
I mean, it was so cute.
It would sit in my lap and just purr all day long,
and I would drag a shoestring on the ground,
-Free cats do that, too, you know.
Look, you guys, I'm really excited about this, okay?
I don't care what you think.
I'm gonna go set up a little litter box for Mrs. Whiskerson.
What am I gonna call her? Fluffy?
-Don't worry, guys, it's not a cat.
I don't know what I'm gonna do with this thing.
-So, why don't you just take it back to where you got it?
-I tried. They won't take her back.
-Well, maybe that's because she's a minion of the Antichrist.
-Great. Why won't they take it back?
but they would only give me store credit.
And, I mean, what am I gonna do?
-Look, if you want, you can keep it at our place
until you find out what to do with it.
I'm out $1,000, I'm all scratched up,
and I'm stuck with this stupid cat
-Oh, my God. What's wrong with your baby?
-That's not a baby, that's a cat.
-Oh, no, no, it's actually -- it's very sweet.
-Well, so then what are you doing to me, okay?
Just get out of here, all right?
I was thinking about getting a cat.
I was just gonna go to the shelter, but...
-I thought you wanted me to adopt your cat.
But you're just gonna have to actually look at this
as more of an investment than a cat.
-Okay, yeah, I just wanted a cat.
Obviously, you know how to haggle,
so I'm not gonna try and take you on, okay?
So $800, and I don't call the cops,
which I should because you are robbing me blind, blind.
You're actually gonna take the cat,
leave the money and run away.
Can't you at least smile or something?
Okay, did anybody just hear that?
-Rachel, what is your cat doing in one of my bowls?
Did you get your money back?
-I just came for the red velvet pillow.
you can come visit her anytime you want.
Some kind of snake or something?
